selection: One location step after the original comparison in none/head/middle/end cyclic order. All available SHA-verified small/medium feeders in size then name order; at most the first two feeders with a joint baseline miss still missing in the actual first-solve warm tree are traced.
root_definition: Union of true groups within two physical edges or two identifiable levels.
clock: The 120 s include the shared first solve and each arm subprocess (including its own startup and builder replay); exclude initial disk reads, NJ/RNJ and nine-tree screening. This supplementary set does not enter the original 120 comparison jobs.

relaxed_budget.protocol: Same two selected feeders, blind inputs and recorded local warm tree. One CPU thread, no whole-process deadline. The four-second anchored domain is reconstructed by a new four-second replay. Pool, anchor requirements and warm tree are recorded for every restricted solve.
